title: Pet Ownership and Glucose Control in Type 1 Diabetes
brief_summary: The investigators' long-term goal is to discover novel, inexpensive and feasible strategies to improve the management and well-being of youth with T1DM. The specific objective of this proposal is to quantify the impact of responsible pet ownership on the glycemic control and health related quality of life in youth with T1DM.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* English-speaking patients
* 10 to 18 years
* diagnosed with type 1 diabetes for at least 12 months
* poor diabetes control as defined by having a hemoglobin A1c value \> 8%

Exclusion Criteria:

* type 2 diabetes
* developmental delay
* current participation in another study that may impact glycemic control
